name: Babak Analysis Knowledge Graph
purpose: Persistent, time-aware graph memory for Babi Hoosh and Tasmim.

node_types.actor: Government, advisor, institution, company, trader or other strategic player
node_types.decision: Policy, public statement, action or inferred strategic choice
node_types.economic_variable: FX, inflation, liquidity, rates, money base, budget, energy, trade, etc.
node_types.market_variable: Index, sector flow, liquidity, sentiment, regime
node_types.commodity: Copper and other relevant global commodities
node_types.option_contract: Option contract with strike, expiry, Greeks, IV, OI and premium
node_types.event: News, filing, macro release, geopolitical or market event
node_types.scenario: Explicit future state with probability and assumptions

edge_types.influences: Strategic influence between actors or institutions

anti_hindsight_rules: Observed outcomes must have a later timestamp than the prediction.
Source timestamps are preserved separately from ingestion timestamps.
Historical records cannot be overwritten; corrections create new versions.
